name: FAKE RACING GAME
source:
Abandoned long ago by the law, G.S.C. is run by the gears—factions of people who have banded together for protection, to barter for resources, and of course, to satisfy their needs. Everything is settled on the road behind the wheel.

Play as the Ghost Driver, a nameless, faceless racer who only drives for himself—until now. Your choices will determine if you can break the undefeated King of Gear Shift City’s winning streak, and steal his favorite boytoy while you're at it. Though you might enjoy losing even more...

[From [url=https://friction-press.itch.io/fkracing]itch.io[/url]]
